import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

namespace BF

/-! ### `Option Int` arithmetic, where `none` plays the role of `+∞`. -/

def oadd : Option Int → Option Int → Option Int
  | some a, some b => some (a + b)
  | some _, none => none
  | none, some _ => none
  | none, none => none

@[simp] lemma oadd_ss (x y : Int) : oadd (some x) (some y) = some (x + y) := rfl
@[simp] lemma oadd_sn (x : Int) : oadd (some x) none = none := rfl
@[simp] lemma oadd_ns (y : Int) : oadd none (some y) = none := rfl
@[simp] lemma oadd_nn : oadd none none = none := rfl

def omin : Option Int → Option Int → Option Int
  | some a, some b => some (min a b)
  | some a, none => some a
  | none, some b => some b
  | none, none => none

@[simp] lemma omin_ss (x y : Int) : omin (some x) (some y) = some (min x y) := rfl
@[simp] lemma omin_sn (x : Int) : omin (some x) none = some x := rfl
@[simp] lemma omin_ns (y : Int) : omin none (some y) = some y := rfl
@[simp] lemma omin_nn : omin none none = none := rfl

def ole : Option Int → Option Int → Prop
  | some a, some b => a ≤ b
  | some _, none => True
  | none, some _ => False
  | none, none => True

@[simp] lemma ole_ss (x y : Int) : ole (some x) (some y) ↔ x ≤ y := Iff.rfl
@[simp] lemma ole_sn (x : Int) : ole (some x) none := trivial
@[simp] lemma ole_ns (y : Int) : ¬ ole none (some y) := fun h => h
@[simp] lemma ole_nn : ole none none := trivial

@[simp] lemma oadd_zero (a : Option Int) : oadd a (some 0) = a := by cases a <;> simp
@[simp] lemma zero_oadd (a : Option Int) : oadd (some 0) a = a := by cases a <;> simp
@[simp] lemma omin_none_right (a : Option Int) : omin a none = a := by cases a <;> simp

lemma oadd_assoc (a b c : Option Int) : oadd (oadd a b) c = oadd a (oadd b c) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp <;> ring

lemma ole_refl (a : Option Int) : ole a a := by cases a <;> simp

lemma ole_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h₁ : ole a b) (h₂ : ole b c) : ole a c := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all <;> omega

lemma ole_antisymm {a b : Option Int} (h₁ : ole a b) (h₂ : ole b a) : a = b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all <;> omega

lemma omin_le_left (a b : Option Int) : ole (omin a b) a := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp <;> omega

lemma omin_le_right (a b : Option Int) : ole (omin a b) b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp <;> omega

lemma omin_eq (a b : Option Int) : omin a b = a ∨ omin a b = b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp <;> omega

lemma oadd_mono {a : Option Int} {w1 w2 : Int} (h : ole a (some w1)) :
    ole (oadd a (some w2)) (some (w1 + w2)) := by
  cases a <;> simp_all <;> omega

/-! ### Minimum of a list. -/

def lmin : List (Option Int) → Option Int
  | [] => none
  | a :: t => omin a (lmin t)

@[simp] lemma lmin_nil : lmin [] = none := rfl
@[simp] lemma lmin_cons (a : Option Int) (t : List (Option Int)) :
    lmin (a :: t) = omin a (lmin t) := rfl

lemma lmin_le : ∀ (l : List (Option Int)) (x : Option Int), x ∈ l → ole (lmin l) x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
    · subst h; exact omin_le_left _ _
    · exact ole_trans (omin_le_right a (lmin t)) (ih x h)

lemma lmin_mem : ∀ (l : List (Option Int)), l ≠ [] → lmin l ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro _
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b t' =>
      rcases omin_eq a (lmin (b :: t')) with h | h
      · rw [lmin_cons, h]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · rw [lmin_cons, h]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih (by simp))

lemma lmin_all_none : ∀ (l : List (Option Int)), (∀ x ∈ l, x = none) → lmin l = none := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    rw [lmin_cons, ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)),
      h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)]
    rfl

/-! ### Edge weights as a function (the graph is simple). -/

def wt (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  if u < g.size then
    match (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = v)) with
    | some pr => some pr.2
    | none => none
  else none

lemma wt_src_lt {g : WeightedGraph} {u v : Nat} {c : Int} (h : wt g u v = some c) :
    u < g.size := by
  by_contra hu
  rw [wt, if_neg hu] at h
  exact Option.noConfusion h

lemma wt_spec (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.has_edge u v w ↔ wt g u v = some w := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, pair, hmem, h1, h2⟩
    rw [wt, if_pos hu]
    cases hf : (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = v)) with
    | none =>
      exfalso
      rw [List.find?_eq_none] at hf
      exact hf pair (by simpa using hmem) (by simp [h1])
    | some q =>
      have hq : q ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
      have hq1 : q.1 = v := by simpa using List.find?_some hf
      have hqe : q = pair := (hwf u hu).2 q pair (by simpa using hq) hmem
        (by rw [hq1, h1])
      simp [hqe, h2]
  · intro h
    have hu : u < g.size := wt_src_lt h
    rw [wt, if_pos hu] at h
    cases hf : (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun pr => decide (pr.1 = v)) with
    | none => rw [hf] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    | some q =>
      rw [hf] at h
      refine ⟨hu, q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
      · simpa using List.find?_some hf
      · simpa using h

lemma wt_target_lt {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat} {c : Int}
    (h : wt g u v = some c) : v < g.size := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hmem, h1, _⟩ := (wt_spec g hwf u v c).mpr h
  have := (hwf u hu).1 pair hmem
  omega

lemma wt_none_of_ge {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat} (hv : g.size ≤ v) :
    wt g u v = none := by
  cases h : wt g u v with
  | none => rfl
  | some c => exact absurd (wt_target_lt hwf h) (by omega)

lemma exists_edge_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (u v : Nat) :
    (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ↔ wt g u v ≠ none := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    rw [(wt_spec g hwf u v w).mp hw]
    exact Option.noConfusion
  · intro h
    cases hc : wt g u v with
    | none => exact absurd hc h
    | some c => exact ⟨c, (wt_spec g hwf u v c).mpr hc⟩

/-! ### Weight of a walk. -/

def pw (g : WeightedGraph) : List Nat → Option Int
  | [] => some 0
  | [_] => some 0
  | u :: v :: rest => oadd (wt g u v) (pw g (v :: rest))

@[simp] lemma pw_nil (g : WeightedGraph) : pw g [] = some 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma pw_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) : pw g [a] = some 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma pw_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (r : List Nat) :
    pw g (u :: v :: r) = oadd (wt g u v) (pw g (v :: r)) := rfl

lemma pw_append (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (l₁ : List Nat) (a : Nat) (l₂ : List Nat),
    pw g (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) = oadd (pw g (l₁ ++ [a])) (pw g (a :: l₂)) := by
  intro l₁
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => intro a l₂; simp
  | cons b t ih =>
    intro a l₂
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons c t' =>
      have e1 : (c :: t') ++ a :: l₂ = c :: (t' ++ a :: l₂) := rfl
      have e2 : (b :: c :: t') ++ [a] = b :: (c :: (t' ++ [a])) := rfl
      show oadd (wt g b c) (pw g (c :: (t' ++ a :: l₂)))
          = oadd (pw g ((b :: c :: t') ++ [a])) (pw g (a :: l₂))
      rw [e2, pw_cons2, ← e1, ih a l₂, oadd_assoc]
      rfl

lemma pw_snoc (g : WeightedGraph) (Q : List Nat) (u v : Nat) :
    pw g ((Q ++ [u]) ++ [v]) = oadd (pw g (Q ++ [u])) (wt g u v) := by
  have h : (Q ++ [u]) ++ [v] = Q ++ u :: [v] := by simp
  rw [h, pw_append]
  simp

lemma head?_snoc (l : List Nat) (hne : l ≠ []) (v : Nat) :
    (l ++ [v]).head? = l.head? := by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons a t => simp

lemma head?_mid (l₁ : List Nat) (a : Nat) (X Y : List Nat) :
    (l₁ ++ a :: X).head? = (l₁ ++ a :: Y).head? := by
  cases l₁ <;> simp

lemma getLast?_snoc (l : List Nat) (a : Nat) : (l ++ [a]).getLast? = some a := by simp

lemma getLast?_app_cons (X : List Nat) (a : Nat) (l₃ : List Nat) :
    (X ++ a :: l₃).getLast? = (a :: l₃).getLast? := by
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat l₃ with h | ⟨L, z, h⟩
  · subst h
    have e : X ++ a :: ([] : List Nat) = X ++ [a] := rfl
    rw [e, getLast?_snoc]
    simp
  · subst h
    have e1 : X ++ a :: (L.concat z) = (X ++ a :: L) ++ [z] := by simp
    have e2 : a :: (L.concat z) = (a :: L) ++ [z] := by simp
    rw [e1, e2, getLast?_snoc, getLast?_snoc]

/-! ### Translating the specification predicates into `pw`. -/

lemma path_weight_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), g.path_has_weight p w ↔ pw g p = some w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro w
    simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight, pw_nil, Option.some.injEq]
    exact eq_comm
  | cons u t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro w
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight, pw_single, Option.some.injEq]
      exact eq_comm
    | cons v r =>
      intro w
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight, pw_cons2]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨we, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩
        rw [(wt_spec g hwf u v we).mp he, (ih wr).mp hr]
        simp
      · intro h
        cases hc : wt g u v with
        | none => rw [hc] at h; cases hd : pw g (v :: r) <;> rw [hd] at h <;> simp at h
        | some c =>
          cases hd : pw g (v :: r) with
          | none => rw [hc, hd] at h; simp at h
          | some d =>
            refine ⟨c, d, (wt_spec g hwf u v c).mpr hc, (ih d).mpr hd, ?_⟩
            rw [hc, hd] at h
            simpa using h.symm

lemma is_path_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), g.is_path p ↔ (p ≠ [] ∧ pw g p ≠ none) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]
  | cons u t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]
    | cons v r =>
      constructor
      · intro hp
        simp only [WeightedGraph.is_path] at hp
        obtain ⟨-, he, hrest⟩ := hp
        have h2 : pw g (v :: r) ≠ none := (ih.mp hrest).2
        refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        rw [pw_cons2]
        have h1 : wt g u v ≠ none := (exists_edge_iff g hwf u v).mp he
        cases hc : wt g u v with
        | none => exact absurd hc h1
        | some c =>
          cases hd : pw g (v :: r) with
          | none => exact absurd hd h2
          | some d => simp
      · rintro ⟨-, hne⟩
        rw [pw_cons2] at hne
        have h1 : wt g u v ≠ none := by
          intro h; rw [h] at hne; cases hd : pw g (v :: r) <;> rw [hd] at hne <;> simp at hne
        have h2 : pw g (v :: r) ≠ none := by
          intro h; rw [h] at hne; cases hc : wt g u v <;> rw [hc] at hne <;> simp at hne
        simp only [WeightedGraph.is_path]
        exact ⟨by simp, (exists_edge_iff g hwf u v).mpr h1, ih.mpr ⟨by simp, h2⟩⟩

lemma pw_some_of_ne_none {g : WeightedGraph} {p : List Nat} (h : pw g p ≠ none) :
    ∃ w, pw g p = some w := by
  cases hc : pw g p with
  | none => exact absurd hc h
  | some w => exact ⟨w, rfl⟩

lemma path_mem_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (z : Nat), p.head? = some z → z < g.size → pw g p ≠ none →
      ∀ y ∈ p, y < g.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro z hh; simp at hh
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro z hh hz hpw y hy
    have hu : u = z := by simpa using hh
    subst hu
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have : y = u := by simpa using hy
      omega
    | cons v r =>
      rw [pw_cons2] at hpw
      have h1 : wt g u v ≠ none := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hpw; cases hd : pw g (v :: r) <;> rw [hd] at hpw <;> simp at hpw
      have h2 : pw g (v :: r) ≠ none := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hpw; cases hc : wt g u v <;> rw [hc] at hpw <;> simp at hpw
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, wt g u v = some c := by
        cases hq : wt g u v with
        | none => exact absurd hq h1
        | some c => exact ⟨c, rfl⟩
      have hv : v < g.size := wt_target_lt hwf hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with h | h
      · omega
      · exact ih v (by simp) hv h2 y h

/-! ### The algorithm. -/

def bfStep (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → Option Int) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  lmin (d v :: (List.range g.size).map (fun u => oadd (d u) (wt g u v)))

lemma bfStep_le_self (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → Option Int) (v : Nat) :
    ole (bfStep g d v) (d v) :=
  lmin_le _ _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)

lemma bfStep_le_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → Option Int) (u v : Nat) (hu : u < g.size) :
    ole (bfStep g d v) (oadd (d u) (wt g u v)) :=
  lmin_le _ _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, List.mem_range.mpr hu, rfl⟩))

lemma bfStep_cases (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → Option Int) (v : Nat) :
    bfStep g d v = d v ∨ ∃ u, u < g.size ∧ bfStep g d v = oadd (d u) (wt g u v) := by
  have h := lmin_mem _ (List.cons_ne_nil (d v) ((List.range g.size).map
    (fun u => oadd (d u) (wt g u v))))
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h' | h'
  · exact Or.inl h'
  · obtain ⟨u, hu, hue⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h'
    exact Or.inr ⟨u, List.mem_range.mp hu, hue.symm⟩

def bfIter (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Int
  | 0 => fun v => if v = s then some 0 else none
  | k + 1 => fun v => bfStep g (bfIter g s k) v

lemma bfIter_succ (g : WeightedGraph) (s k v : Nat) :
    bfIter g s (k + 1) v = bfStep g (bfIter g s k) v := rfl

lemma bfIter_anti (g : WeightedGraph) (s k : Nat) :
    ∀ (j v : Nat), ole (bfIter g s (k + j) v) (bfIter g s k v) := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro v; exact ole_refl _
  | succ j ih =>
    intro v
    exact ole_trans (bfStep_le_self g (bfIter g s (k + j)) v) (ih v)

lemma bfIter_stable_high (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (k v : Nat)
    (hv : g.size ≤ v) : bfIter g s (k + 1) v = bfIter g s k v := by
  rw [bfIter_succ, bfStep, lmin_cons,
    lmin_all_none _ (by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨u, -, hue⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      rw [← hue, wt_none_of_ge hwf hv]
      cases bfIter g s k u <;> simp)]
  exact omin_none_right _

/-! ### Soundness: the DP never underestimates. -/

lemma bf_le (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (p : List Nat) (w : Int) (v : Nat), p.head? = some s → p.getLast? = some v →
      pw g p = some w → p.length ≤ k + 1 → ole (bfIter g s k v) (some w) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p w v hh hl hpw hlen
    match p, hh, hl, hpw, hlen with
    | [a], hh, hl, hpw, _ =>
      have h1 : a = s := by simpa using hh
      have h2 : a = v := by simpa using hl
      have h3 : (0 : Int) = w := by simpa using hpw
      subst h1; subst h2; subst h3
      show ole (if a = a then some 0 else none) (some 0)
      simp
    | a :: b :: t, hh, hl, hpw, hlen => simp at hlen
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p w v hh hl hpw hlen
    by_cases hsmall : p.length ≤ k + 1
    · exact ole_trans (bfStep_le_self g (bfIter g s k) v) (ih p w v hh hl hpw hsmall)
    · push_neg at hsmall
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, p = q ++ [v] := by
        rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat p with h | ⟨q, b, h⟩
        · subst h; simp at hh
        · have hb : b = v := by rw [h] at hl; simpa using hl
          exact ⟨q, by rw [h, hb]; simp⟩
      have hqne : q ≠ [] := by
        intro h; subst h; simp at hsmall
      obtain ⟨Q, u, rfl⟩ : ∃ Q u, q = Q ++ [u] := by
        rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat q with h | ⟨Q, u, h⟩
        · exact absurd h hqne
        · exact ⟨Q, u, by rw [h]; simp⟩
      rw [pw_snoc] at hpw
      cases hpq : pw g (Q ++ [u]) with
      | none => rw [hpq] at hpw; cases hc : wt g u v <;> rw [hc] at hpw <;> simp at hpw
      | some w1 =>
        cases hwv : wt g u v with
        | none => rw [hpq, hwv] at hpw; simp at hpw
        | some w2 =>
          rw [hpq, hwv] at hpw
          have hw : w = w1 + w2 := by simpa using hpw.symm
          have hhq : (Q ++ [u]).head? = some s := by
            rw [← head?_snoc (Q ++ [u]) (by simp) v]; exact hh
          have hlq : (Q ++ [u]).length ≤ k + 1 := by
            simp at hlen ⊢; omega
          have h1 := ih (Q ++ [u]) w1 u hhq (by simp) hpq hlq
          have h2 := bfStep_le_edge g (bfIter g s k) u v (wt_src_lt hwv)
          rw [bfIter_succ]
          refine ole_trans h2 ?_
          rw [hwv, hw]
          exact oadd_mono h1

/-! ### Completeness: the DP value is attained by an actual walk. -/

lemma bf_attain (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (x : Int), bfIter g s k v = some x →
      ∃ p : List Nat, p ≠ [] ∧ p.head? = some s ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ pw g p = some x ∧
        p.length ≤ k + 1 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v x hx
    by_cases hv : v = s
    · have h0 : bfIter g s 0 v = some 0 := by
        show (if v = s then some 0 else none) = some 0
        simp [hv]
      rw [h0] at hx
      have hx0 : (0 : Int) = x := by simpa using hx
      exact ⟨[v], by simp, by simp [hv], by simp, by simp [← hx0], by simp⟩
    · exfalso
      have : bfIter g s 0 v = none := by show (if v = s then some 0 else none) = none; simp [hv]
      rw [this] at hx
      exact Option.noConfusion hx
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v x hx
    rw [bfIter_succ] at hx
    rcases bfStep_cases g (bfIter g s k) v with h | ⟨u, hu, h⟩
    · rw [h] at hx
      obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih v x hx
      exact ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, by omega⟩
    · rw [h] at hx
      cases hd : bfIter g s k u with
      | none => rw [hd] at hx; cases hc : wt g u v <;> rw [hc] at hx <;> simp at hx
      | some y =>
        cases hc : wt g u v with
        | none => rw [hd, hc] at hx; simp at hx
        | some c =>
          rw [hd, hc] at hx
          have hxe : x = y + c := by simpa using hx.symm
          obtain ⟨q, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih u y hd
          obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ : ∃ Q, q = Q ++ [u] := by
            rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat q with h' | ⟨Q, b, h'⟩
            · exact absurd h' h1
            · have hb : b = u := by rw [h'] at h3; simpa using h3
              exact ⟨Q, by rw [h', hb]; simp⟩
          refine ⟨(Q ++ [u]) ++ [v], by simp, ?_, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [head?_snoc _ (by simp)]; exact h2
          · rw [pw_snoc, h4, hc, hxe]; simp
          · simp at h5 ⊢; omega

/-! ### Extracting a repeated vertex. -/

lemma dup_decomp (a : Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat), List.Sublist [a, a] l →
    ∃ l₁ l₂ l₃, l = l₁ ++ a :: (l₂ ++ a :: l₃)
  | [], h => by simp at h
  | b :: t, h => by
    cases h with
    | cons _ h' =>
      obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, l₃, hd⟩ := dup_decomp a t h'
      exact ⟨b :: l₁, l₂, l₃, by rw [hd]; rfl⟩
    | cons₂ _ h' =>
      obtain ⟨s, u, hd⟩ := List.append_of_mem (List.singleton_sublist.mp h')
      exact ⟨[], s, u, by rw [hd]; rfl⟩

end BF
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bellman_ford (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if (List.range graph.size).all (fun v =>
      decide (BF.bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1 + 1) v
        = BF.bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1) v)) then
    some ((List.range graph.size).map (fun v => BF.bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1) v))
  else
    none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : Option (List (Option Int)))
    (_ : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dists =>
      dists.length = graph.size ∧
      ∀ v, v < graph.size →
        match dists.getD v none with
        | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
        | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  | none =>
      graph.has_negative_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace BF

lemma some_case (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (m : Nat)
    (hall : ∀ v, bfIter g s (m + 1) v = bfIter g s m v) (v : Nat) :
    match bfIter g s m v with
    | some d => g.is_shortest_dist s v d
    | none => ¬ ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some s ∧ p.getLast? = some v := by
  have hstab : ∀ (j v : Nat), bfIter g s (m + j) v = bfIter g s m v := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro v; rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      intro v
      have hfun : bfIter g s (m + j) = bfIter g s m := funext ih
      show bfStep g (bfIter g s (m + j)) v = bfIter g s m v
      rw [hfun]
      exact hall v
  have hle_all : ∀ (k : Nat), ole (bfIter g s m v) (bfIter g s k v) := by
    intro k
    rcases le_or_lt k m with h | h
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, m = k + j := ⟨m - k, by omega⟩
      rw [hj]
      exact bfIter_anti g s k j v
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, k = m + j := ⟨k - m, by omega⟩
      rw [hj, hstab j v]
      exact ole_refl _
  cases hb : bfIter g s m v with
  | some d =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, hne, hh, hl, hpw, -⟩ := bf_attain g s m v d hb
      exact ⟨p, (is_path_iff g hwf p).mpr ⟨hne, by rw [hpw]; exact Option.noConfusion⟩, hh, hl,
        (path_weight_iff g hwf p d).mpr hpw⟩
    · intro p w hp hh hl hw
      have hpw : pw g p = some w := (path_weight_iff g hwf p w).mp hw
      have h1 := bf_le g s hwf (p.length - 1) p w v hh hl hpw (by omega)
      have h2 := ole_trans (hle_all (p.length - 1)) h1
      rw [hb] at h2
      exact h2
  | none =>
    rintro ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := pw_some_of_ne_none ((is_path_iff g hwf p).mp hp).2
    have h1 := bf_le g s hwf (p.length - 1) p w v hh hl hw (by omega)
    have h2 := ole_trans (hle_all (p.length - 1)) h1
    rw [hb] at h2
    exact h2

lemma neg_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hs : s < g.size)
    (m : Nat) (hm : g.size = m + 1) (v : Nat)
    (hne : bfIter g s (m + 1) v ≠ bfIter g s m v) : g.has_negative_cycle := by
  have hmono : ole (bfIter g s (m + 1) v) (bfIter g s m v) :=
    bfStep_le_self g (bfIter g s m) v
  cases hb1 : bfIter g s (m + 1) v with
  | none =>
    exfalso
    rw [hb1] at hmono
    cases hb0 : bfIter g s m v with
    | none => exact hne (by rw [hb1, hb0])
    | some z => rw [hb0] at hmono; simp at hmono
  | some x =>
    rw [hb1] at hmono
    obtain ⟨p, hpne, hh, hl, hpw, hlen⟩ := bf_attain g s (m + 1) v x hb1
    have hplen : p.length = m + 2 := by
      by_contra hcon
      have hle : p.length ≤ m + 1 := by omega
      have h1 := bf_le g s hwf m p x v hh hl hpw hle
      exact hne (by rw [hb1, ole_antisymm h1 hmono])
    have hmem : ∀ y ∈ p, y < g.size :=
      path_mem_lt g hwf p s hh hs (by rw [hpw]; exact Option.noConfusion)
    have hnd : ¬ p.Nodup := by
      intro hnd
      have h1 : p.toFinset.card = p.length := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd
      have h2 : p.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range g.size := by
        intro y hy
        exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hmem y (List.mem_toFinset.mp hy))
      have h3 := Finset.card_le_card h2
      rw [h1, Finset.card_range] at h3
      omega
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, List.Sublist [a, a] p := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hnd (List.nodup_iff_sublist.mpr hcon)
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, l₃, rfl⟩ := dup_decomp a p ha
    -- split the weight of `p` into the prefix, the cycle and the suffix
    have e1 := pw_append g l₁ a (l₂ ++ a :: l₃)
    have e2 : pw g (a :: (l₂ ++ a :: l₃))
        = oadd (pw g ((a :: l₂) ++ [a])) (pw g (a :: l₃)) := pw_append g (a :: l₂) a l₃
    have e3 := pw_append g l₁ a l₃
    rw [e2] at e1
    rw [e1] at hpw
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α, pw g (l₁ ++ [a]) = some α := by
      cases hc : pw g (l₁ ++ [a]) with
      | none => rw [hc] at hpw; cases hd : oadd (pw g ((a :: l₂) ++ [a])) (pw g (a :: l₃)) <;>
          rw [hd] at hpw <;> simp at hpw
      | some α => exact ⟨α, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ, pw g ((a :: l₂) ++ [a]) = some γ := by
      cases hc : pw g ((a :: l₂) ++ [a]) with
      | none => rw [hα, hc] at hpw; cases hd : pw g (a :: l₃) <;> rw [hd] at hpw <;> simp at hpw
      | some γ => exact ⟨γ, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β, pw g (a :: l₃) = some β := by
      cases hc : pw g (a :: l₃) with
      | none => rw [hα, hγ, hc] at hpw; simp at hpw
      | some β => exact ⟨β, rfl⟩
    rw [hα, hγ, hβ] at hpw
    have hx : x = α + (γ + β) := by simpa using hpw.symm
    -- the walk with the cycle removed
    have hp'w : pw g (l₁ ++ a :: l₃) = some (α + β) := by rw [e3, hα, hβ]; simp
    have hh' : (l₁ ++ a :: l₃).head? = some s := by
      rw [head?_mid l₁ a l₃ (l₂ ++ a :: l₃)]; exact hh
    have hl' : (l₁ ++ a :: l₃).getLast? = some v := by
      rw [getLast?_app_cons]
      have hp : l₁ ++ a :: (l₂ ++ a :: l₃) = (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) ++ a :: l₃ := by simp
      rw [hp, getLast?_app_cons] at hl
      exact hl
    have hp'len : (l₁ ++ a :: l₃).length ≤ m + 1 := by
      simp at hplen ⊢; omega
    have hA := bf_le g s hwf m (l₁ ++ a :: l₃) (α + β) v hh' hl' hp'w hp'len
    -- compare with the (m+1)-st iteration to conclude the cycle is negative
    have hneg : γ < 0 := by
      cases hb0 : bfIter g s m v with
      | none => rw [hb0] at hA; simp at hA
      | some z =>
        rw [hb0] at hmono hA
        simp only [ole_ss] at hmono hA
        have hxz : x ≠ z := by
          intro h; exact hne (by rw [hb1, hb0, h])
        omega
    refine ⟨(a :: l₂) ++ [a], γ, ?_, ?_, ?_, (path_weight_iff g hwf _ γ).mpr hγ, hneg⟩
    · exact (is_path_iff g hwf _).mpr ⟨by simp, by rw [hγ]; exact Option.noConfusion⟩
    · simp
    · rw [getLast?_snoc]; simp

end BF
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bellman_ford_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) :
    bellman_ford_postcond graph start
      (bellman_ford graph start h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hs, -⟩ := h_precond
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, graph.size = m + 1 := ⟨graph.size - 1, by omega⟩
  have hsz : graph.size - 1 = m := by omega
  unfold bellman_ford
  by_cases hc : (List.range graph.size).all (fun v =>
      decide (BF.bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1 + 1) v
        = BF.bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1) v)) = true
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    simp only [hsz, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    have hall : ∀ v, BF.bfIter graph start (m + 1) v = BF.bfIter graph start m v := by
      intro v
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge v graph.size with hv | hv
      · exact hc v hv
      · exact BF.bfIter_stable_high graph start hwf m v hv
    simp only [bellman_ford_postcond]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    have hget : ((List.range graph.size).map
        (fun v => BF.bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1) v)).getD v none
        = BF.bfIter graph start m v := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simp [hv])]
      simp [hsz]
    rw [hget]
    exact BF.some_case graph start hwf m hall v
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    simp only [hsz, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨v, -, hvne⟩ := hc
    exact BF.neg_cycle graph start hwf hs m hm v hvne
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## What I did

Only the four marker regions of `Solution.lean` were edited.

**Implementation (computable).** The `def bellman_ford` signature sits outside the editable region, so a classical/`noncomputable` definition was not an option — this is real Bellman–Ford:

- `oadd`/`omin`/`ole` on `Option Int`, with `none = +∞` (hand-rolled instead of `WithTop Int` so the return type matches exactly and no lattice instance is needed).
- Because the graph is *simple*, edge weight is a **function** `wt g u v : Option Int`, with `wt_spec : has_edge u v w ↔ wt g u v = some w`. That collapses the relational `path_has_weight`/`is_path` specs into one walk-weight function `pw`, which is what makes the splicing arguments tractable.
- `bfIter (k+1) v = min (bfIter k v, min_{u<n} (bfIter k u + wt u v))`, run to `n-1`, plus the `n`-th check via `List.all`.

**Verification.** Both challenges named in the task are discharged:

1. *Relaxation invariant* — `bf_le`: any walk `start → v` with ≤ `k+1` vertices and weight `w` satisfies `bfIter k v ≤ w`; `bf_attain`: conversely `bfIter k v = some x` is realized by an actual walk of ≤ `k+1` vertices. In the success branch, equality at step `n` propagates to all `k` (`hstab`), so `bfIter (n-1)` is the true shortest distance, and `none` entries are provably unreachable.
2. *Negative-cycle detection* — `neg_cycle`: a still-improving vertex yields a walk with exactly `n+1` vertices, all `< n`; pigeonhole (via `toFinset.card`) gives a repeat, `dup_decomp` splits `p = l₁ ++ a :: l₂ ++ a :: l₃`, and `pw_append` splits the weight as `α + γ + β`. The cycle-free residual has ≤ `n` vertices, so `bf_le` forces `α + γ + β < α + β`, i.e. `γ < 0` — an explicit witness for `has_negative_cycle`.

One caveat worth stating plainly: the postcondition's `none` case only demands *some* negative cycle, and that's what I prove — reachability from `start` is not required by the spec, though the cycle I construct does in fact lie on a walk from `start`. Also, correctness is proved but not efficiency: `bfIter` recomputes previous layers rather than threading an array, so it is exponential-time as written; nothing in the specification constrains complexity.

analysis:
The student’s submission does satisfy the semantic requirements.

Why it matches Bellman-Ford:
- The core algorithm is implemented explicitly, not by calling a library shortest-path routine.
- `bfStep` computes, for each vertex `v`, the minimum of:
  - the current distance `d v`, and
  - all candidate relaxations `d u + w(u,v)` over all `u` in `List.range g.size`.
- `bfIter` starts with distance `0` at `start` and `none` elsewhere, then applies `bfStep` repeatedly.
- The final `bellman_ford` function checks whether one more iteration changes any distance:
  - if no change after the extra iteration, it returns the distances after `|V|-1` iterations,
  - otherwise it returns `none`.
This is exactly the Bellman-Ford pattern: relax edges for `|V|-1` rounds, then do one more pass to detect a reachable negative cycle.

Handling of negative weights / negative cycles:
- The algorithm uses `Int` weights and does not assume nonnegativity.
- It returns `none` when an additional relaxation is possible after `|V|-1` rounds, corresponding to negative-cycle detection.
- The accompanying lemmas/proof regions are aimed at showing shortest-path correctness and negative-cycle existence.

Simple graph requirement:
- The teacher-owned scaffold defines `well_formed` to enforce unique targets per adjacency list (no parallel edges from the same source to the same target), and the precondition requires `graph.well_formed`.
- The implementation respects this representation and uses it in `wt_spec`.

No cheating:
- No `sorry`, `admit`, empty body, or fake implementation appears in the student-owned regions.
- No forbidden shortcut via an existing Bellman-Ford or shortest-path library function is used.
- The algorithm is implemented from scratch with its own relaxation operator and iteration scheme.

Minor note:
- The implementation is vertex-centric (`for each v, inspect all u`) rather than edge-list-centric, but semantically this is still Bellman-Ford relaxation over all edges and is acceptable.
- It checks equality of the whole DP state between iterations rather than directly checking “some edge can still relax,” but this is an equivalent negative-cycle detection criterion in this setup.

Overall, the student implemented the required Bellman-Ford algorithm and did not use compiler-tricking shortcuts.
